base:
Use the supplied reference image as the visual style reference for a REVISED KoBi Reports mobile screen. Create ONE single portrait mobile UI screenshot, 9:16, flat straight-on edge-to-edge app view, no phone frame, no collage. Preserve the reference's warm Pixel Stickers stationery style: wine ink and stepped outlines, vanilla paper, sand backing folders, gold active-tab/main action, restrained hard offset shadows, tiny cherry folds. Use Bungee for titles and ALL buttons/tab labels and Yanone Kaffeesatz for supporting copy and field text. Keep typography readable.

MANDATORY CORRECTIONS TO THE REFERENCE, higher priority than reference geometry:
1. The folder assembly occupies the FULL WIDTH of the app viewport from the left edge to the right edge. Its body is a full-bleed page section, NOT a narrow centred folder/card. Left and right outer folder edges reach the screen edges. Only the CONTENT INSIDE the folder has comfortable padding. Do not reserve empty gutters outside the folder; do not expose a staircase of sheet edges down either side.
2. This is the DEFAULT LANDING STATE with Report active. Show EXACTLY FOUR HORIZONTAL TOP TABS in ONE left-to-right row in this exact order: 'Report' then 'Received' then 'In progress' then 'Resolved'. Each tab has its own dedicated nonoverlapping position, approx quarters of screen width; 'In progress' may wrap to two lines inside its third tab. All four sit on the SAME TOP BASELINE. Report at far left is selected gold. Remaining three sand. Each tab is physically connected to a paper-folder silhouette. The tabs must NOT be staggered into a second row or reordered by sheet layering. No extra copy of Report below the tab row.
3. There are ZERO VERTICAL LABELS VISIBLE ANYWHERE in this landing screenshot: no Report word on the right edge, no Received vertical word, no side protrusions, no vertical label on the left. Secondary right-edge labels exist only offscreen and must be COMPLETELY HIDDEN at default; never draw them. All visible folder labels are the four top horizontal labels only.
4. The active full-width folder body starts directly under the tab row, runs to the bottom navigation, and contains the reporting form directly. NO 'New report' button.

STYLE AND COPY: UI surfaces/lettering/icons only these five flat colours: wine #6C1A21, cherry #B92C2C, gold #CEA257, sand #D1BF9A, vanilla #E5E0CD. No gradients, blurred shadows, texture, black, white, green UI, rounded pills, copied random typography captions. Pixel facility illustrations may use the same warm palette. Header KoBi at left, small 'Demo mode' notice, hamburger right. Reports page title. Facility carousel ABOVE tabs with selected playground swing-and-slide pixel art in a stepped frame, left/right arrows and small neighbour previews, name 'Playground', supporting location 'Block A'. Carousel selects a facility. Bottom nav Map / Reports / Activities / Profile with Reports selected. Remove accidental text from the reference such as 'Yanone Kaffeesatz' inside demo banner and 'Live' beneath facility picture.

FOLDER CONTENT: 'Report a problem' heading and tiny paper-report icon. Context 'Playground · Block A'. Field label 'Problem title', value 'Broken swing seat'. Field label 'Description', multiline value 'One swing seat is damaged and cannot be used safely.' Label 'Photo (optional)', camera icon and 'Add photo'. Full-width gold ticket button 'Send report'. Small footer 'Demo only · Saved on this browser'. Comfortable normal square typing fields; no giant icon or decoration crowding form. Render every essential field and submission button legibly. Same content/facility across approaches. This is visual design concept only. Ensure the exact ordered four top tabs and full-width sheet are unmistakable.

variants.name: Balanced full-width folders
variants.direction: APPROACH 1: Closest to the reference, corrected and well-balanced. Keep roughly the reference carousel size and header proportions. Folder row begins around 39% of screen height. One clear gold Report index tab at far left, other three sand on same baseline; full-width vanilla sheet below with a thin gold top rim and wine outline. Full-width sand context band inside, generous form padding, compact photo row. Retain small cherry corner-fold detail ONLY inside upper-right of content area, never a protruding side label. Gold Send report with stepped ticket ends and small hard shadow. Friendly civic stationery look very close to the reference.

variants.name: Wide gold folder frame
variants.direction: APPROACH 2: Bolder folder architecture, same reference style. Folder row starts around 35% height. A substantial GOLD frame band runs along the top and inside edges of the full-bleed active vanilla sheet, wine stepped outline and hard shadow. Four top index tabs on exactly one baseline in exact left-to-right order; active Report gold connected seamlessly to gold frame, three others sand. A compact small report sticker sits next to section heading; form fields have slim wine borders and generous spacing. Facility carousel modest rather than dominant. Full-width context strip on sand, main form vanilla. Visual hierarchy derives from confident gold framing and large clear labels; no side rails or extra vertical tabs.

variants.name: Large facility, compact file
variants.direction: APPROACH 3: Facility-led proportions while keeping the reference stationery look. Enlarge the central playground picture and its stepped gold/wine frame so carousel fills much of upper third; show small side previews and clear arrow controls. Folder row begins around 44% height. Four horizontal tabs exactly on one baseline in stated sequence across full viewport. Full-bleed vanilla sheet below with restrained stepped corners, sand top context band and fine wine dividers. Compact readable form with a shorter description field and compact photo row, Send report button visible above bottom nav. Distinct larger facility composition, quieter folder frame than approach 2, no right-edge labels and no outer folder gutters.

variants.name: Large file, compact facility
variants.direction: APPROACH 4: Folder-led proportions, strongest emphasis on reporting form. Compact carousel strip with selected playground thumbnail noticeably smaller than reference, its Playground/Block A labels clear, neighbour previews and arrows still visible. Four horizontal index tabs begin around 28% height in one exact ordered row. Full-viewport-width vanilla active folder occupies almost all remaining height above bottom nav. Broad quiet form with a large roomy Description area and a neat photo attachment rectangle containing camera icon/Add photo. Larger Report a problem heading and understated paper icon; sand context line, simple wine field borders, restrained gold tab and gold action. Thin crisp folder rim and minimal hard shadows rather than the heavy gold frame approach. All four tab labels visible and in sequence, absolutely no vertical default labels.
